test_item:
KeyInstall feature should prevent installation any non-platform specific keys.
(non-platform raw keys; installstate is ERROR (3))
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. A USB drive containing non-platform raw keys has been inserted into the HU USB port
proc:
1. Read the installation state file in the secure partition
$ adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/<installstate file>
2. Read the status value in the secure partition
$ adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/<status file>
er:
1. The adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/<installstate file> output shows the installstate value 3
2. The adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/<status file> output shows "0900 0000 0000 0000"
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:

sibling axis: key platform scope; rule 1,4 of SEC-04 4.2
channel_feasible: Y/Y
